scientific_integrity: The general statements are proved using exact polynomial-ring and Chinese-remainder arguments. Finite Boolean-matrix and orbit enumeration are corroborating, not a proof for arbitrary size. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the stated synchronous three-neighbor anti-conformist parity rule on simple cubic prisms is analyzed. The exact primitive-period enumeration is for dyadic circumferences, with a general reversibility and transient-core law for all circumferences. No assertion is made about random network typicality or the absence of earlier equivalent linear-algebraic formulations.
title: Three-divisibility and exact dyadic orbit census in cubic anti-conformist opinion networks
